Very disappointed with my experience with the Nykaa Fashion app.

I understand if an order gets delayed by 2–4 days, but my order was delayed by almost 20 days and still remained in the “Confirmed” status without being shipped for a long time. Thankfully, I had chosen Cash on Delivery (COD). After this experience, I don’t think I can trust this app for prepaid orders.

When the order was finally delivered after nearly 20 days, the size didn’t fit, so I requested a return. It’s been 5+ days, and no one has come for the pickup.

Trying to contact customer support was even more frustrating. I waited on the customer care line for 10–15 minutes, but no one answered. The chat support is extremely slow—there is often a 10-minute gap between each reply, making it impossible to have a real conversation.

The most surprising part was their response regarding my return. They said there was a technical issue and they couldn’t arrange pickup from my address, asking me to provide another pickup location. This makes no sense. If they were able to deliver the order to my address, why can’t they pick it up from the same location?

Overall, the delivery, return process, and customer support have been extremely disappointing. I would not recommend Nykaa Fashion based on my experience
